questions.title: Definition of Recursion in C
questions.description: Which statement best defines recursion in C?
questions.Option1: A function that calls itself directly or indirectly
questions.Option2: A function that calls another function once
questions.Option4: A function declared with the static keyword

questions.title: Purpose of Base Case in Recursion
questions.description: What is the role of the base case in a recursive function?
questions.Option1: It stops the recursion from continuing indefinitely
questions.Option2: It is the first call to the function from main

questions.title: Effect of Missing Base Case
questions.description: What happens if a recursive function has no base case?
questions.Option1: Stack overflow due to unbounded calls

questions.title: Call Stack Usage in Recursion vs Iteration
questions.description: Between recursion and iteration, which typically uses more call stack space?
questions.Option1: Recursion, because each call adds a stack frame
questions.Option2: Iteration, because loops use the stack

questions.title: Primary Purpose of Inline Functions
questions.description: What is the primary purpose of marking a function inline?
questions.Option1: Reduce function call overhead by substituting the body at the call site
questions.Option2: Force the compiler to optimize all loops

questions.title: Recursion on Strings Index Parameter
questions.description: In a recursive function that traverses a C string, which parameter is most commonly used to track position?
questions.Option1: An integer index incremented in each recursive call
questions.Option4: The original string length as a constant
